title: What chefs do
d: Chefs run professional kitchens: menu planning, station cooking, expediting, ordering, and leading brigades under pressure. The path runs from culinary school o
description: Chefs run professional kitchens: menu planning, station cooking, expediting, ordering, and leading brigades under pressure. The path runs from culinary school or dish pit through stations to sous chef and executive chef. It is hot, fast, and demanding — and deeply rewarding.

title: Essential tools
d: Chef's knife (8-10 inch), paring knife, serrated bread knife, honing steel, cutting boards, tongs, fish spatula, thermometer, mandoline, and quality pans. Perso
description: Chef's knife (8-10 inch), paring knife, serrated bread knife, honing steel, cutting boards, tongs, fish spatula, thermometer, mandoline, and quality pans. Personal kit: knife roll, thermometer, and tasting spoons.

title: Key skills
d: Knife skills: speed with safety. Mise en place: everything in its place before service. Cooking methods across all stations. Seasoning by taste, not recipe. Tim
description: Knife skills: speed with safety. Mise en place: everything in its place before service. Cooking methods across all stations. Seasoning by taste, not recipe. Timing multiple dishes to land together. Leading calmly when the tickets pile up.

title: Safety essentials
d: Knife safety: claw grip, sharp knives, cut away. Burn prevention: dry towels, announce hot. Slip prevention: clean as you go. Food safety: temperatures, cross-c
description: Knife safety: claw grip, sharp knives, cut away. Burn prevention: dry towels, announce hot. Slip prevention: clean as you go. Food safety: temperatures, cross-contamination, handwashing — the health inspector is always coming.

title: Getting started
d: Culinary school or start as a dishwasher/prep cook and learn by doing. Stage (trail) at good restaurants. Master garde manger, then sauté, then grill. The best
description: Culinary school or start as a dishwasher/prep cook and learn by doing. Stage (trail) at good restaurants. Master garde manger, then sauté, then grill. The best education is working under chefs better than you.

title: Pro tips
d: Taste everything, constantly. Clean as you go — a messy station is a slow station. Sharpen daily, hone constantly. Learn the why behind techniques, not just the
description: Taste everything, constantly. Clean as you go — a messy station is a slow station. Sharpen daily, hone constantly. Learn the why behind techniques, not just the how. Take care of your body: this trade is physical.
